text:
{
  "name": "wlan_rx_beacon_process",
  "confidence": "medium",
  "docstring": "Processes a received 802.11 beacon frame during scan: extracts the DS channel IE, validates against the expected frequency (2.4/5 GHz band tables), walks frame-body IEs to locate the TIM (tag 5) for power-save, computes a CRC32 over the body to detect BSS parameter changes, triggers PHY calibration and scan events, prepares a response descriptor, and notifies the host via HCI.",
  "subsystem": "mac",
  "var_renames": {
    "v4": "frame_ctx",
    "v5": "frame_total_len",
    "v6": "rx_buf_ptr",
    "v7": "vif_scan_ctx",
    "v25": "prev_body_crc",
    "v9": "found_ie_ptr",
    "v10": "ds_ie_channel",
    "v11": "expected_freq_mhz",
    "v14": "body_crc",
    "v16": "ie_cursor",
    "v17": "vif_scan_ctx_save",
    "v18": "remaining_body_len",
    "v19": "ie_value_len",
    "v20": "ie_value_ptr",
    "v23": "scan_phase",
    "v12": "global_state_ptr"
  },
  "struct_hints": [
    {"offset": 28, "meaning": "uint16 — total received frame length (header + body)"},
    {"offset": 8, "meaning": "uint32 — pointer to rx descriptor; descriptor+8 = packet data buffer"},
    {"offset": 45, "meaning": "uint8 — scan phase / channel index (passed to event_dispatch and rf_iq_calibrate)"},
    {"offset": 107, "meaning": "uint8 — PHY calibration parameter (passed to mmio_write_phy)"},
    {"offset": 116, "meaning": "uint8 — PHY channel number (passed to phy_channel_validate)"},
    {"offset": 120, "meaning": "uint32 — elapsed tick / timestamp threshold for scan timeout"},
    {"offset": 124, "meaning": "uint32 — CRC32 of frame body (written with computed value, compared against previous at entry)"},
    {"offset": 128, "meaning": "uint8 — packet accept/filter flag (zeroed on channel mismatch or IE-not-found)"},
    {"offset": 141, "meaning": "uint8 — beacon-received flag (set to 1 after processing)"},
    {"offset": 146, "meaning": "uint16 — post-calibration delay/timer (zeroed when PHY calibrate triggered)"},
    {"offset": 147, "meaning": "uint8 — PHY calibration pending flag"},
    {"offset": 148, "meaning": "uint8 — scan sub-state flag (zeroed alongside calibration timer)"},
    {"offset": 414, "meaning": "uint16 — expected channel center frequency in MHz (from scan channel list)"},
    {"offset": 414, "meaning": "uint16 — expected channel center frequency in MHz (2407+5*ch or 5000+5*ch)"}
  ]
}
